claims.statement: After his 1876 fight with Joe Goss, Tom Allen went to Chicago and told Mike McDonald he would fight Jem Mace for $10, or as much as Mace could raise.
claims.excerpt:
I told Mike I would fight Mace
for $10 or as much more as Jem could raise.

claims.statement: Tom Allen said he was robbed of his 1876 fight with Joe Goss on a claim of foul, and that Goss's backers got about $10,000 from it.
claims.excerpt:
After I had been
robbed out of the fight and I got back

claims.statement: Johnny Dyer, one of Goss's seconds, offered to fight Tom Allen for $1,000 at Cincinnati, and forfeited after a $250 forfeit was posted for a four-week match.
claims.excerpt:
We put up a $250 forfeit to
fight in four weeks, but he forfeited.

claims.statement: After the Goss fight, Tom Allen and Jem Mace travelled together around the country, Allen billed and acknowledged as champion of the world.
claims.excerpt:
I was billed and acknowledged as the
champion of the world, and Mace is the
ex-champion.

claims.statement: Tom Allen said he was the only pugilist who ever left America open to fight any man living.
claims.excerpt:
I am the only pugilist who
ever left this country, open to fight
any man living.

claims.statement: Tom Allen said that on arriving in England he beat all the best men there and retired from the ring.
claims.excerpt:
On my arrival in England I
beat all the best men of that country and
retired.

claims.statement: Tom Allen said he was 39 years old when he retired, after nineteen years in the ring.
claims.excerpt:
I was then 39 years of age, and had
been in the ring nineteen years.

claims.statement: In this letter Tom Allen said he had thirty-four years' experience in the prize ring.
claims.excerpt:
my thirty-four years’ experience in the
prize ring.

claims.statement: Billy Madden, an old beer-slinger of Tom Allen's, later took Jack Sullivan to New York.

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: In my time we had prize fights; now there are boxing matches with top-heavy purses hung up.

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: I am the only pugilist who ever left this country, open to fight any man living.

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: The public is to blame for going to their shows. They would box oftener if their houses were smaller.
quotes.topic: blames the public for modern boxing

notes: Allen's letter, signed Thos. Allen. Not reconciled: says 19 years in the ring when he retired at 39, and 34 years' experience in 1895. Dave Kendal, Eph Holland and others who took the Goss purse are left out as minor detail.
